items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: from Contrails, to listen to his style of playing, I always liked to dress a band with plenty of rolls on the snare drum.

ctx.x: How did you play in the old days in the dance bands? As much as you're playing today, the same sort of stuff?

Well, I never really changed my style of playing. I just tried to, except I played almost the same. I just always liked to, from Contrails, to listen to his style of playing, I always liked to dress a band with plenty of rolls on the snare drum. Because them days we didn't have a whole lot of tulip with tum-tums and plenty of cymbals, you see. So everything would depend on the bass and the snare drum. So I just tried to fill in a band with plenty of snare drum.
I guess that's like most of the drummers was doing the same thing.
